mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than a baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of FEDFUNDS decline, or the discount rate compression effect is offset by rising inflation expectations.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) triggers a loss of investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing above 5.5%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals economic expansion, amplifying equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day returns are not positively correlated with the interaction of GDPC1 and INDPRO (p > 0.05), or the effect diminishes in non-expansionary regimes.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, sustained increases in the federal funds rate raise borrowing costs, reducing corporate earnings growth and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS rising in a tightening cycle, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 10-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising labor market employment (PAYEMS) signals strong job growth, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not positively correlated with PAYEMS growth (p > 0.05) during periods of strong labor demand, or the effect is muted in recessions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in the supply of goods (INDPRO > 105) indicates reduced production constraints, lowering inflationary pressures and encouraging equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to rise when INDPRO exceeds 105, or the correlation is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices amplifies economic activity, driving up corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day returns are not positively correlated with the interaction of GDPC1 and INDPRO (p > 0.05), or the effect is absent in non-expansionary regimes.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle labor market expansion, rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) create sustained momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns fail to rise despite both PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline in the specified regime, or the correlation is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 3-year window.
